newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman signs free trade zone pact with Yemen.
newsitem.headline: Oman signs free trade zone pact with Yemen.

text.p: Oman has signed a deal to establish a free trade zone near the city of Mazyuna close to the Oman-Yemen border to boost imports, exports and re-exports between the two countries, a statement received on Sunday said.

"The agreed cost of realising the project is 460,000 Omani rials ($1.2 million) and the realisation will take 365 days," said a statement by the minister of commerce and industry Makboul bin Ali Bin Sultan, who signed the accord on Saturday.

The zone was the first step in a series of measures to develop the border region, the statement said. It would help promote ties between the two countries, especially in terms of the economy and trade. -- Dubai newsroom +9714 6071 219
